sources.title: whisper-small-quran-lora-dataset-mix - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Whisper Small Quran (LoRA Fine-Tuned) This is a specialized Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) model for Quranic Recitation. It is a fine-tuned version of openai/whisper-small, optimized to recognize Quranic Arabic with high accuracy while maintaining excellent inference speed. Model Performance

sources.title: GitHub - openai/whisper: Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak ...
sources.snippet: Whisper is a general-purpose speech recognition model. It is trained on a large dataset of diverse audio and is also a multitasking model that can perform multilingual speech recognition, speech translation, and language identification.

sources.title: B-I-T-W-I-S-E-M-I-N-D-S/Whisper-LORA - GitHub
sources.snippet: Model Adaptation: Applies LoRA adapters to the Whisper model to enable efficient fine-tuning. Optimization: Employs mixed-precision training (fp16) and the Accelerate library for efficient GPU utilization. Training Loop: Incorporates early stopping based on validation performance to prevent overfitting.
